note: Touch-first Crispy Doom launcher: GTK4 WAD picker, fullscreen Crispy Doom wrapper, and the bridge route that maps io.github.fabiangreffrath.Doom to it. Userspace only; each file is staged, SHA-256 verified, atomically installed and rolled back on failure.

groups.component: Crispy Doom touch launcher and bridge route
groups.health_check: systemctl is-active nuxel-http-bridge && python3 -m py_compile /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-doom-launcher /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/flatpak_provider.py && curl -fsS -m 10 http://127.0.0.1:8080/api/v1/ping >/dev/null
groups.rollback: restore the .nuxel-rollback copies of /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-doom-launcher, /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-crispy-doom, /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-flatpak-doom and /usr/lib/nuxel/nuxel-bridge/flatpak_provider.py, then restart nuxel-http-bridge
